title: 第6章倒反天罡
novel_title: 伪装隐世仙族后，大佬疯狂跪舔我
content_zh:
她想，或许是刚刚少女的出场方式太过震撼，才让自己产生了这种感觉。

    金丹妖兽开道，全身疑似天阶灵宝的装饰，还有不知实力的大佬相护，自己家里确实没有这种实力。

    “想跟本小姐一起走，你确定？”

    对于这个原剧情里退婚叶不凡的反派女配，微生璃月观感不错，退婚归退婚，该给的补偿她全都给了，后期剧情里也不曾去蹭叶不凡未婚妻这个身份。

    只是因为退婚过男主，就一直被人念叨嘲讽，每次男主境界提升，他们就会觉得是濮阳明珠不懂得珍惜，才错过了这么好的夫婿。

    实际上，谁会喜欢一个身边全是莺莺燕燕的种马？

    要是换做微生璃月，她要做的第一件事也是退婚。

    “确定，我想跟微生小姐一起走。”濮阳明珠点点头。

    “既然这样，看在你还算比较合本小姐眼缘的份上，就允你跟本小姐同行了！”

    “来，拉住。”

    微生璃月将自己袖口的一段递到濮阳明珠面前，让她拉好。

    此时已经开始出发登上问心路上的人们回头看到这一幕，不知道濮阳小姐为什么要去讨好这个刁蛮大小姐。

    她就是一个废物五灵根，难不成还想靠她带飞自己？

    然而下一刻，众人仿佛看到什么不可思议的东西，眼神中尽是震惊。

    濮阳明珠不懂微生小姐让自己拉住衣袖是什么意思，是怕自己路上走丢或者跟不上？

    既然她说了要一起走，就肯定会等对方的。

    可事情似乎跟她想的不太一样，谁能告诉她，为什么在拉上对方衣袖之后，自己整个人就飞了起来。

    问心路上，金莲沿路盛开，其中最大的那朵金莲里，两个十五六岁的少女迎风而立。

    耳边是呼啸的风声，鼻尖萦绕着少女身上的清香，濮阳明珠甚至还没意识到发生了什么，人就已经来到太虚宗日常训练广场上。

    她们这是……抵达目的地了？
content_en:
She thought that maybe it was the way the girl appeared just now that was so shocking that made her feel this way.

The golden elixir demon beast opened the way, its whole body was decorated like a heaven-level spiritual treasure, and it was protected by a boss who didn't know its strength. He really didn't have this kind of strength in his family.

"You want to go with me, are you sure?"

Weisheng Liyue had a good impression of the villainess who broke off the engagement to Ye Bufan in the original plot. She gave all the compensation she deserved for breaking off the engagement, and she never took advantage of Ye Bufan's status as his fiancée in the later plot.

Just because the male protagonist broke off the engagement, they have been talked about and ridiculed. Every time the male protagonist's realm improves, they will feel that the Puyang Pearl does not know how to cherish, so they missed such a good husband.

In fact, who would like a stallion surrounded by warblers and swallows?

If it were Weisheng Liyue, the first thing she would do is break off the engagement.

"Sure, I want to go with Miss Weisheng." Puyang Mingzhu nodded.

"In this case, since you are quite popular with me, I will allow you to go with me!"

"Come on, hold on."

Weisheng Liyue handed a piece of her cuff to Puyang Mingzhu and asked her to pull it up.

At this time, people who had already started to board the Wenxin Road looked back and saw this scene, wondering why Miss Puyang wanted to please this unruly young lady.

She is a useless Five Spiritual Root, is it possible that he still wants to rely on her to lead him away?

However, the next moment, everyone seemed to see something incredible, and their eyes were full of shock.

Puyang Mingzhu didn't understand what Miss Weisheng meant when she asked her to hold her sleeves. Was she afraid that she would get lost on the road or not be able to keep up?

Since she said she wanted to go together, she would definitely wait for him.

But things seemed to be different from what she thought. Who could tell her why she flew up after pulling on the other party's sleeves.

On Wenxin Road, golden lotuses bloomed along the road. In the largest golden lotus, two girls of fifteen or sixteen years old stood facing the wind.

With the whistling wind in his ears and the fragrance of the girl lingering on his nose, Puyang Mingzhu had already arrived at the Taixu Sect's daily training square before he even realized what was happening.

Have they... arrived at their destination?
